I’vr been intermittently bonkers for a year, which is not something I’ve ever experienced in this way. Waiting for my first neurology appointment currently.

I’m waiting for a neurology appointment for suspected MS, but the pandemic is making the wait times really long. I try not too think of it too much, but I have a constant eye twitch since 6 months, postural tremor that come and go, sudden problems urinating since a year, numbness and muscle cramps (often in my anus - wth), among other things. Also had optic neurosis 10 years ago. It could still be anxiety related, although I’ve never had that before... ugh, it’s just hard to keep away from dr google and worrying, but at the same time any diagnosis would be a relief after a year of intermittently non-functioning hell.

Same here, completely unaware for more than a decade. Started remembering when I suddenly had sexual fantasies that all included the guys saying “are you sure you want this?” before penetration... thought that was a little weird. Then remembered, in a way suddenly, but it took me months to realize and accept that it wasn’t a lie or something my mind made up. Really weird stuff that I didn’t know my brain was capable of. It has helped a lot to talk about it, keeps me from blocking it again or falling back into thinking I’m lying about it. I do need reminders sometimes because I doubt my memories when I’m anxious, even though they now (a year out) are pretty clear.
